models.description: Session tracking for all actor logins. Nullable FKs reflect actor role. Tracks multi-device, multi-actor, and compliance obligations. Timestamps are atomic. Strict 3NF, no token reuse. Example: customer and seller each have their own sessions, with traceable origin and timings.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: FK to customer session. Nullable; only filled when session is for customer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: FK to seller session. Nullable; only filled when session is for seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_admin_id
foreignFields.description: FK to admin session. Nullable; only filled when session is for admin.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Opaque, securely generated session token for authentication. Unique per session.

plainFields.name: session_type
plainFields.description: Type marker: 'web', 'mobile', 'api', etc. Enables multi-channel support.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of session origin. Recorded for audit, compliance, and fraud analysis.

plainFields.name: authenticated_at
plainFields.description: Auth time (UTC, required). Used for compliance and last login tracking.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration time/date. Enforces security, supports audit retention policies.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_products
models.description: Product master table - Implements requirements from the Product Management module, enabling sellers to register, manage, update, and track products through their lifecycle. Maintains 3NF by reference-linking to sellers, categories, and separating options, inventory, tags, and snapshots to discrete tables. Used for registering new items, searching products, assembling bundles, and supporting audit traceability. Key relationships: seller (actor), category, inventory, options, tags, bundles, AI recommendations. Special behaviors: unique SKU constraint per seller, supports full audit traceability via snapshots and timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for this product. References existing shopping_mall_ai_sellers table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_category_id
foreignFields.description: Main category reference. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title (multi-language handled outside this table). Represents main display label.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description for display. Maintains normalization by storing only base string here, not translations or formatted content.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product. Implements pricing requirement from catalog management - atomic field (no aggregation).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status lifecycle state (active, inactive, archived, etc). Implements requirement for workflow, returns, search. 3NF: not derived from other fields.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Product Stock Keeping Unit. Enforces business uniqueness within each seller (composite key constraint).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Row creation timestamp for audit trail. Not nullable, part of audit compliance.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update for audit trail. Not nullable, required for audit compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_categories
models.description: Product category list (hierarchical) - Implements product categorization and navigation requirements. Maintains normalization by referencing parent self-row for hierarchy and separating product assignment. Used for category browsing, assigning products, and analytics. Key relationships: self-parent, products. Unique constraint prevents duplicate category names under same parent. Special behaviors: parent_id can be null (root category); unique name within parent. Fully auditable via timestamps.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent category for hierarchy. Null means root category. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name used for filtering, display, analytics. Not null, enforces clear navigation structure.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order among siblings. Implements UI/UX display requirement. Atomic, not calculated.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Is this category active and visible to users? Not null, supports search/filtering.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Category creation time for audit. Not null.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Category last update time for audit. Not null.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles
models.description: Product bundle master - Implements requirement for composite/bundle product types (multi-SKU). Maintains normalization by separating bundle/product mapping (via multi-relation). No calculated fields; price is explicit. Used for registering, querying, activating bundles. Key relationships: M:N with products. Audit support via timestamps. Behavioral notes: Only active bundles shown to customers; price is not auto-summed from products, always explicit.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Name of this bundle, used for search, navigation, analytic reporting. Atomic.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Bundle overview text. Implements requirement for informative description. Atomic.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Bundle price (explicit, not calculated). Implements business requirement for flexibility and control.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Is this bundle available/visible now? Used for customer-facing filtering and search.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Bundle creation time for audit row. Not nullable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Bundle last update time for audit trail. Not nullable.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_inventories
models.description: Inventory tracking table - Implements strict real-time inventory control and auditability (per product and option-variant granularity). Follows 3NF by separating inventory and reservation state from products/options and excluding calculated values. Used for up-to-date stock validation and operational reporting. Relationships: FK to product, FK to option (nullable for base inventory). Auditable by timestamps. Unique inventory row per product/option. Key usage: reservation and availability queries, restock planning, shortage control. Special: Reserved cannot exceed quantity (enforced at application level).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Tracked product FK. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id
foreignFields.description: Optional FK for option-variant specificity. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_product_options.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity available in this inventory record. Implements atomic tracking of stock (not derived/calculated).

plainFields.name: reserved_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity reserved for fulfillment, not available for immediate sale. Separated for normalization and process control.

plainFields.name: restock_at
plainFields.description: When new stock is expected (null if not planned). Supports supply chain visibility and planning. Optional.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Inventory row create audit. Not nullable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Inventory row last update audit. Not nullable.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots
models.description: Product snapshot and versioning - Implements audit requirement for historical record of every change (register, update, delete) for compliance and analysis. Normalized by storing all persistent product data as serialized JSON (no denormalized fields here). Used for rollback, admin audit, and analytics. Relationships: FK to product. Behavioral notes: Only created_at timestamp kept (no modified field).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: FK to tracked product ({@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}).

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Action that caused this snapshot (created/updated/deleted etc). Implements requirement for change log granularity.

plainFields.name: snapshot_json
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON state of product at snapshot. 3NF-compliant; not calculated, atomic data blob.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time the change was snapshotted (never null).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_options
models.description: Product options (variants) - Implements multi-attribute SKU structures (size/color/etc.) separate from product records per normalization. Used for registration of product attributes, pricing structures, inventory granularity. Relationships: FK to product, unique SKU per product/option. Behavioral: Option_sku is always unique within product. Atomic, not calculated.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: FK to parent product ({@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Option category name such as Size/Color. Required for variant registration.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option value, e.g., "Large" or "Red". Implements flexible attribute design.

plainFields.name: option_sku
plainFields.description: Single SKU for this option/variant within the parent product requirement. Uniqueness enforced.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Created at (audit row). Not nullable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated at (audit row). Not nullable.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_tags
models.description: Product-tag M:N mapping - Implements flexible tagging for user search, analytics, AI recommendations (per requirements). Strict 3NF: each row is atomic, reference to one product and one tag. Used for assigning labels (seasonal, thematic, marketing), tagging analytics. Uniqueness constraint prevents duplicate tag for same product. Fully auditable.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: FK to associated product ({@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}).

plainFields.name: tag
plainFields.description: Text label for analytical/category/feature search. Not null, atomic, not derived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit field, row creation time. Not null.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_ai_recommendations
models.description: AI recommendation mapping - Implements surfacing requirement for AI-driven product recommendations per channel. Strict normalization: one mapping per product/channel, metadata stored as atomic blob. Used to link products to channels for tailored display/AI suggestions. Fully auditable, not calculated in table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: FK to target product ({@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: FK to channel ({@link shopping_mall_ai_channels.id}), already created.

plainFields.name: metadata_json
plainFields.description: Opaque serialized metadata for recommendation reasons, model output, etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (auditable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (auditable).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_carts
models.description: Shopping cart representing short-lived user intent before checkout. Implements the requirement for separating intent/mutable cart state from transactional orders (see Cart & Order System doc). Maintains strict 3NF by isolating customer, channel, and section as FKs. For example, guest carts have null customer ID; multi-seller split is enabled by seller_id. Key relationships: links to customers/products/sessions/items. Special behaviors: cart can expire or be deleted if unused.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. Nullable for guest carts (intent tracking without persistent identity).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller (if cart is seller-specific). Used for multi-seller/split-cart scenarios.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel the cart was created from (web/app/partner). Required for tracking context and analytics.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_section_id
foreignFields.description: Mall section/category that the cart applies to (for analytics, marketing, campaign scope).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for cart record. Used in cart expiry and abandoned cart logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time the cart was first created. Used for audit trail and analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_cart_items
models.description: Cart item records - each row represents an atomic product/option/quantity selected in a cart. Implements requirement for normalized item representation in the Cart & Order System; avoids denormalized arrays. Usage example: Customer adds 2 products to cart, two rows are created. Key relationships: references carts and products; optional product_option for variants. Special behaviors: supports audit via timestamps, quantity changes, updates.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Parent cart for this item (1:N relationship; must reference shopping_mall_ai_carts.id).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being considered for purchase (must reference shopping_mall_ai_products.id).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product option (e.g., color/size variant chosen; nullable if product has no variants).

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity chosen in this cart item row. Atomic to maintain normalization and enable accurate order creation.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Time this item was added to cart. Used for analytics and audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time item was last modified. Used for detecting stale/reserved items.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_cart_sessions
models.description: Tracks guest/member session linkage to carts, enabling resume/sharing/expiration by session or device. Implements requirement for decoupling ephemeral session/cart lifecycles. Maintains normalization with session_token and cart FK (unique per token). For example, returning guest resumes session by session_token lookup. Key relationships: each session links to one cart. Special behaviors: auto-expiry, support guest/member migration.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_cart_id
foreignFields.description: The cart this session is linked to. 1:N mapping for session to cart. Required for all records.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Opaque token binding session to cart (guest modes, device restoration, etc.). Must be unique.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. Used for audit and recall.

plainFields.name: last_active_at
plainFields.description: Most recent activity timestamp for session expiry/cleanup.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_orders
models.description: Order record for each completed checkout event - This implements the need for atomic, auditable transaction records as per cart/order system and compliance requirements. Business purpose: provides a persistent, auditable record of sales including references to customer, channel, and all transactional relationships. Technical context: references customers, channels (both from other components), and aggregates items/payments/shipments. Maintains strict 3NF normalization; order-level calculated/summary fields are NOT stored here. Used for all order reporting, fulfillment, and analytics workflows. Key relationships: customer (buyer), channel (origin), order_items (breakdown), payments, shipments. Special behaviors: Immutable after completion for legal compliance. Timestamps support audit and temporal analytics.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key - Unique identifier for each order, enforcing entity integrity and traceability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: References the customer who placed the order. Links to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id} from Actors domain for audit and reporting. Ensures 3NF normalization by externalizing identity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel through which the order was placed. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_channels.id} for analytics and multi-channel support. Fully normalized design.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status (pending, paid, shipped, cancelled, completed). Implements requirement for full order lifecycle management. 3NF by isolating state as atomic value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of order creation - Implements audit and analytics requirements. Ensures non-redundant atomic values (3NF). Used for event ordering and tracing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification - For audit and compliance reporting. Maintains temporal integrity and normalization.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_items
models.description: Atomic breakdown for each product or SKU included in an order - Implements the requirement for line-item auditability and support for returns/analytics. Each row represents one discrete unit, normalized by separating all product/item info. Business purpose: supports quantity, price, and option-specific fulfillment, enabling precise return/cancel handling. Technical context: references order, product, and option from respective domains. Maintains strict 3NF. Used for inventory deduction, refund calculations, and SKU-level reporting. Key relationships: parent order, product/option, possibly option for variants. Special behaviors: status tracking for line-level returns/exchanges.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key - Unique identifier for each order item, enforcing atomicity and referential integrity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_id
foreignFields.description: Link to parent order's {@link shopping_mall_ai_orders.id} for 1:N relationship. Maintains strict normalization.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the purchased product. Ties to {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id} from ProductCatalog. Allows accurate analytics and inventory management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to specific option/variant (nullable). Allows option-level granularity for stock/price tracking. Null means base product was selected. 3NF: no stored denormalized attributes.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price at order placement (not recalculated or aggregated later). 3NF: strictly atomic at point of entry, supports revenue recognition/audit.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: How many of this SKU/option were purchased in this line. Implements cart/order requirement. No aggregates.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Line status (e.g., active, returned, cancelled) - Enables detailed return/exchange workflows. 3NF: lone code.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp: entry creation (for audit trails, reporting).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp: last update (for returns/exchanges processing, analytics).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_payments
models.description: Payment transaction detail entity - Implements the requirement for split/multi-method payment scenarios, full audit trail, and financial reconciliation. Business purpose: tracks all payment and refund events, supporting post-sale processes. Technical context: references both order and payment channel. Enforces audit and compliance (timing and result tracking). 3NF: no redundant summaries. Used for payout reconciliation, fraud checks, and financial history. Key relationships: order, channel. Special behaviors: nullable resolution timestamp supports in-progress events.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key - Unique identifier for payment event, enabling precise financial and compliance tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_id
foreignFields.description: References the order for which this payment occurred. {@link shopping_mall_ai_orders.id}. Maintains strict normalization.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to payment channel/context (e.g., mobile, web, marketplace) - links to {@link shopping_mall_ai_channels.id} for multi-channel analytics. 3NF normalization.

plainFields.name: method
plainFields.description:
Payment method code (business determines available values). Implements 1payment type tracking for analytics/compliance.
Example: card, deposit, coupon, etc.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current payment status (pending, success, fail, refunded). Required for fintech workflow tracing. Not calculated.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid/refunded. Always atomic; reflects only this event, not order sum.

plainFields.name: initiated_at
plainFields.description: When payment event initiated. Used for reconciliation, compliance, and reporting.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: When payment event resolved (nullable if in progress). Applies to audit requirement.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_shipments
models.description: Entity for logistics/fulfillment event(s) in order lifecycle - Implements requirement for multi-shipment, per-order event/fulfillment tracking as required in Cart & Order and Product Management. Business purpose: supports partial/delayed/split-shipment structures; enables full audit and reporting. Technical context: references parent order (from this domain), tracks logistics status and optional provider details. 3NF normalization, no denormalized product addresses or redundant tracking. Used for delivery time metrics, lost/delay resolution, and compliance. Key relationships: order, (future: 1:N item/shipment lines). Special behaviors: provider, tracking number nullable for pickup/non-carrier methods.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key - Unique for each shipment/fulfillment event, supports reliable auditing of shipping workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order this shipment is tied to. References {@link shopping_mall_ai_orders.id}. Maintains normalized structure for multi-shipment workflows.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of shipment (pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, etc.) as per workflow and analytics requirement. Implements workflow, full compliance with 3NF.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking code for logistics provider (nullable for pickup, non-trackable methods). Supports logistics integration.

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: Shipping/carrier provider name (nullable; carrier integration optional).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of shipment entity - used for reporting and compliance.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update/delivery timestamp; supports audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_coupons
models.description: Coupon definition entity implementing the requirements for system, seller, or product-specific coupons. This model ensures uniqueness of coupon codes, supports flexible targeting (seller/product/channel), and tracks business rules such as stacking, validity, and maximum use. Maintains 3NF by separating coupon event logs and preventing aggregate fields. Used when a customer attempts to redeem a coupon, and by admins for auditing eligibility, fraud, and campaign efficacy. Key relationships: events ({@link shopping_mall_ai_coupon_events}), seller ({@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers}), product ({@link shopping_mall_ai_products}), and channel ({@link shopping_mall_ai_channels}). Special behavior: status flags enforce suspension/expiration, unique index prevents reuse of codes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Issuer seller (nullable for platform-wide coupons). References {@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_product_id
foreignFields.description: Applicable product (nullable = all products). References {@link shopping_mall_ai_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel scope (nullable = global coupon). References {@link shopping_mall_ai_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Coupon code - unique per coupon. Implements global eligibility requirement. E.g., 'SUMMER24', 'SELLER10'.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Discount type, e.g., 'fixed', 'percent', or 'free_shipping'. Implements promo strategy selection.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Discount value; business meaning depends on coupon type (fixed, %). Enforces atomic value for 3NF.

plainFields.name: min_order_value
plainFields.description: Minimum order requirement for coupon use. Null = no restriction. Ensures separation from usage event data (normalization).

plainFields.name: max_usage
plainFields.description: Max global redemptions for this coupon. Implements business anti-abuse rule. Atomic, 3NF-compliant.

plainFields.name: max_usage_per_customer
plainFields.description: Max redemptions per customer. Enforces usage limit; 3NF-compliant.

plainFields.name: valid_from
plainFields.description: Coupon start date/time (UTC). Supports audit/eligibility logic.

plainFields.name: valid_until
plainFields.description: Coupon expiry (UTC). Required by business expiry rules and status auto-update.

plainFields.name: stackable
plainFields.description: Can this coupon be combined with others? Implements stacking business rule.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Coupon lifecycle status (e.g., active, expired, suspended). Triggers usage logic and admin control. 3NF-atomic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Coupon creation timestamp (audit/traceability requirement).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Coupon row update timestamp (audit, compliance).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_coupon_events
models.description: Coupon issuance, redemption, and audit event log. Implements audit trail and business fraud review requirement. Each event links a coupon to its associated customer and/or order (if applicable), and includes timestamp, type, and actor/admin info if needed. 3NF: no duplicate/calc data, all events atomic. Used to query redemption, abuse, or issue/expiry history. Relationships: coupon ({@link shopping_mall_ai_coupons}), customer ({@link shopping_mall_ai_customers}), order ({@link shopping_mall_ai_orders}), actor ({@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers} or {@link shopping_mall_ai_admins}).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Coupon being referenced. FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_coupons.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Involved customer (nullable for non-customer events). FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order affected by event (nullable). FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor performing/logging event (seller/admin; nullable for system events). FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_ai_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of event for audit (issued, redeemed, expired, flagged, reviewed, etc.). Fulfills compliance and anti-abuse rules.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of event action (3NF-audit).

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Business or compliance note explaining event. Null = no comment.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_deposits
models.description: User deposit balance ledger implementing store credit management per refund, promotional grant, or manual adjust. Atomic model, 3NF (no aggregates). No pre-calc/rollup values. Used for customer eligibility checks and to power refund flows. Key relationship: customer ({@link shopping_mall_ai_customers}). Special behaviors: unique constraint on (customer, origin, status) to prevent duplicates/fraud.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer owning this deposit. FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: balance
plainFields.description: Store credit balance for user (never negative). 3NF-compliant; no rollup. Used for eligibility/audits.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time for auditability.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Deposit lifecycle status (active, expired, etc.). Used by audit and credit eligibility checks.

plainFields.name: origin
plainFields.description: Originating event for credit (e.g., refund). Implements business rules for refund tracking and analytic reporting.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration date/time for credit (nullable). Enforces rule for time-limited promo/refund deposits.

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_mileage_points
models.description: Reward program point accrual/redemption/adjust event log. Fulfills loyalty point requirements (earning, redemption, admin adjust). Each record reflects an atomic event — 3NF. Used to power customer-facing point balances and admin reviews. Key relationship: customer ({@link shopping_mall_ai_customers}).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer for the event. FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: point_type
plainFields.description: Type of mileage event (accrual, redemption, adjustment) — supports rule compliance and admin audit.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Number of points changed; sign indicates earning (+) or redemption (-). 3NF events only (never rolled up in this table).

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Details (e.g., campaign code, admin note). Nullable, compliance-friendly.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Time of event (audit/compliance req).

models.name: shopping_mall_ai_loyalty_events
models.description: Loyalty system event log for audit, fraud review, and compliance snapshots. Used to track all major actions impacting loyalty/points, including admin overrides, expiry, and customer appeals. Each row is atomic and 3NF with full traceability. Relationships: customer ({@link shopping_mall_ai_customers}), optional actor ({@link shopping_mall_ai_admins} or seller).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Affected customer. FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_ai_actor_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or seller who executes/approves event. FK to {@link shopping_mall_ai_admins.id} or seller. Nullable for system events.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of loyalty event (awarded, redeemed, expired, revoked, reviewed, etc.). Supports audit/compliance rules.

plainFields.name: points
plainFields.description: Quantitative points for event. Nullable if event non-numeric (e.g., review/flag). 3NF for rollup prevention.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional info for audit. Null = no detail.

plainFields.name: occurred_at

### `shopping_mall_ai_channels`

Shopping mall channel definition for platform multi-channel, omni-channel configuration. Implements requirement for channel-level separation and enables web, mobile, external integrations. Maintains 3NF: all channel attributes are atomic, reusable, and no calculations or redundancy. Used for administration, business rule selection, and UI partitioning. Key relationships: One-to-many with sections. Special behaviors: Code uniqueness and business logic mapping.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies a channel (web, app, partner marketplace).
- `code`: Technical channel code (e.g., 'web', 'mobile_app', 'marketplace'). Uniquely identifies channel for platform business rules and selection. Ensures atomicity (1NF/3NF) by separating label from reference. Used in integration logic and admin UI.
- `name`: Display name for channel in admin/UX context. Implements name/label separation from code for normalization and UI flexibility. Used for admin/global reporting.
- `active`: Channel activation toggle (true = channel available, false = hidden/inactive). Implements activation/deactivation requirement without removing definition. Maintains atomic 3NF compliance—does not duplicate business status elsewhere.
- `config`: Arbitrary channel-specific configuration as JSON (string). Used for variable settings (e.g., branding, endpoints). Enables open-ended config without denormalizing standard columns—maintains normalization. Used by devops and expanded integrations.
- `created_at`: When channel definition was created (audit/logging). Implements platform-level audit and traceability. Ensures 3NF: one fact per field.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for channel (for audit, troubleshooting). Supports system-wide consistency and change history retention. Used by operations and admin UI.

### `shopping_mall_ai_sections`

Logical application section of the shopping mall platform (e.g., 'catalog', 'checkout'). Implements requirement for modular, channel-specific configuration and flexibility. Maintains strict 3NF—each attribute atomic; section-channel relationship enforces hierarchy on normalized key. Examples: Each channel may support distinct set of sections (multi-tenant/cross-app). Key relationships: Belongs to channel (shopping_mall_ai_channels). Special behaviors: (code,channel) composite unique constraint for business logic mapping.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies a logical application section (e.g., catalog, checkout).
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Associated channel's primary key reference ([shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels)). Maintains referential integrity for cross-section/channel hierarchy.
- `code`: Section code for business logic and navigation mapping (e.g., 'home', 'products'). Implements atomicity and enables unique business lookup per channel. 3NF: no code redundancy within channel.
- `name`: Admin-facing section name for labeling and reporting. Separated from code for normalization/usability.
- `active`: Section enabled/disabled toggle for runtime configuration and navigation control. Enables UX flexibility without data deletion. 3NF: atomic, non-redundant.
- `config`: Section-specific extensibility point for arbitrary configuration (JSON as string). Implements open-ended setup without denormalizing core entity.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for section, supporting audit trail of platform structure. Implements audit consistency across entities.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (for admin/ops audit and troubleshooting). 3NF compliance: strictly atomic fact.

### `shopping_mall_ai_configurations`

Global configuration registry/settings for the shopping mall platform. Implements requirement for centrally managed, system-wide tunables such as site name, URLs, or flags. Maintains 3NF: each setting is represented atomically; no derived or calculated data. Used in global application startup, platform migration, or runtime toggling. Key relationships: None (standalone, not externally referenced). Special behaviors: Unique key required; audit fields always populated.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies a configuration entry.
- `key`: Configuration key (e.g., 'site_title', 'api_gateway_url'). Implements atomic config separation for code/access. 3NF: no redundant info.
- `value`: String/JSON value for the configuration (arbitrary business data as string). May be interpreted by business logic code as needed. Maintains normalization.
- `active`: Config enabled/disabled switch (active/inactive). 3NF: pure flag, never derived. Allows staged rollouts or toggling without removing records.
- `created_at`: Timestamp for config creation (audit and troubleshooting). Maintains auditability for ops and compliance.
- `updated_at`: Last config update timestamp; supports system troubleshooting and rollback history. 3NF: atomic, auditable, never derived.

### `shopping_mall_ai_customers`

Customer account entity for authentication and shopping activity. Implements user onboarding, role separation, and RBAC requirements. Maintains strict 3NF by keeping password, registration data, and identity attributes atomic and referencing sessions/roles externally. Example: customer logs in via email, manages account, and owns shopping sessions. Key relationships: sessions table (1:N), channel FK. Special behaviors: nickname unique in channel, soft disable via is_active.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique customer identifier.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Belonged sales channel's [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels).
- `email`: Email for authentication. Unique per customer. Used for login and communications.
- `password`: Hashed password for secure login. Never stored as plain text. Critical for user authentication.
- `nickname`: Display nickname unique per channel. Used for display and personalized settings.
- `registered_at`: Datetime the customer registered. Used for audit trail, onboarding time analysis.
- `is_active`: Whether the account is active. Used for compliance suspensions, user-initiated deactivation.

### `shopping_mall_ai_sellers`

Seller account model — distinct from customer — for merchant product management. Implements seller registration, KYC/audit, and seller-side session/auth. Strict 3NF, all key business fields atomic. Key relationships: onboarding workflow (1:N), sessions (1:N), channel FK. Example: seller registers, progresses through onboarding, and gains product listing rights after admin approval. Special behaviors: business verification (verified), email uniqueness enforced.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique seller ID.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Operating channel's [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels).
- `email`: Email for seller authentication, unique. Supports login, recovery, and notifications.
- `password`: Seller password hash for secure login. No plain text storage, RBAC enforcement.
- `name`: Display/business name for the seller. Used across mall assets and shop settings.
- `verified`: Business verification status. True if KYC/admin approval completed. Supports onboarding/audit workflow.
- `registered_at`: Datetime seller registered. Used for onboarding analytics/compliance.
- `is_active`: Active status. Used for compliance/account suspensions/soft block.

### `shopping_mall_ai_admins`

Admin account: platform superuser with staff-level authority. Tracks audit, onboarding approvals, and manages permissions. All key fields atomic, no denormalization. Key relationships: sessions (1:N), onboarding approvals (1:N). Example: admin creates, audits sellers, and owns system configuration. Special: staff_id must be unique. Follows strict 3NF.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique admin identifier.
- `email`: Admin's unique email for login and notifications. RBAC entry point.
- `password`: Password hash for admin login. Never stored as plain text. Used for security enforcement.
- `name`: Staff/admin display name. Used for admin area displays and audit logs.
- `staff_id`: Unique staff identifier. Used for audit, traceability, compliance reporting.
- `registered_at`: Datetime staff/admin was registered. Audit and compliance reporting.
- `is_active`: Whether admin account is active. Can be toggled for security/reorgs.

### `shopping_mall_ai_seller_onboardings`

Seller onboarding/audit workflow. Captures KYC/approval step, admin assignment, and doc upload. Key relationships: seller (required), admin (optional, after approval). Maintains atomic onboarding status markers and timestamps. Used for regulatory compliance and admin enforcement. Strict 3NF.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique onboarding workflow instance.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Seller undergoing onboarding. FK to [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers).
- `shopping_mall_ai_admin_id`: Admin assigned to/approved this onboarding; nullable FK to [shopping_mall_ai_admins.id](#shopping_mall_ai_admins).
- `status`: Current onboarding status for workflow and business rules. Ex: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.
- `started_at`: Datetime onboarding was started. Used for in-progress analytics and workflow tracing.
- `completed_at`: Nullable: Completion datetime for onboarding. Only set if completed/approved.
- `business_document_url`: URI to uploaded business docs for KYC. Used for regulatory compliance/audit.

### `shopping_mall_ai_role_permissions`

RBAC row-level grant/deny for mall actors. All fields atomic per strict normalization. Ensures only allowed actions are permitted by actor, role, and permission string. Example: grant seller 'issue_coupon', deny customer 'approve_seller'. Strict 3NF; no denormalization/caching.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique mapping row.
- `actor_type`: Actor domain: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'. Used for RBAC and audit.
- `role_name`: Role group. Ex: 'pending_seller', 'seller', 'customer', 'admin'. Policy enforcement granularity.
- `permission_key`: Permission/action string. Ex: 'manage_products', 'list_orders', 'issue_coupons'.
- `granted`: If true, permission is allowed for this row. Otherwise denied/blocked.

### `shopping_mall_ai_sessions`

Session tracking for all actor logins. Nullable FKs reflect actor role. Tracks multi-device, multi-actor, and compliance obligations. Timestamps are atomic. Strict 3NF, no token reuse. Example: customer and seller each have their own sessions, with traceable origin and timings.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key. Unique session instance.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: FK to customer session. Nullable; only filled when session is for customer.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: FK to seller session. Nullable; only filled when session is for seller.
- `shopping_mall_ai_admin_id`: FK to admin session. Nullable; only filled when session is for admin.
- `session_token`: Opaque, securely generated session token for authentication. Unique per session.
- `session_type`: Type marker: 'web', 'mobile', 'api', etc. Enables multi-channel support.
- `ip_address`: IP address of session origin. Recorded for audit, compliance, and fraud analysis.
- `authenticated_at`: Auth time (UTC, required). Used for compliance and last login tracking.
- `expires_at`: Session expiration time/date. Enforces security, supports audit retention policies.

### `shopping_mall_ai_products`

Product master table - Implements requirements from the Product Management module, enabling sellers to register, manage, update, and track products through their lifecycle. Maintains 3NF by reference-linking to sellers, categories, and separating options, inventory, tags, and snapshots to discrete tables. Used for registering new items, searching products, assembling bundles, and supporting audit traceability. Key relationships: seller (actor), category, inventory, options, tags, bundles, AI recommendations. Special behaviors: unique SKU constraint per seller, supports full audit traceability via snapshots and timestamps.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Seller responsible for this product. References existing shopping_mall_ai_sellers table.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_category_id`: Main category reference. References [shopping_mall_ai_product_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_categories).
- `title`: Product title (multi-language handled outside this table). Represents main display label.
- `description`: Product description for display. Maintains normalization by storing only base string here, not translations or formatted content.
- `price`: Base price of the product. Implements pricing requirement from catalog management - atomic field (no aggregation).
- `status`: Status lifecycle state (active, inactive, archived, etc). Implements requirement for workflow, returns, search. 3NF: not derived from other fields.
- `sku`: Product Stock Keeping Unit. Enforces business uniqueness within each seller (composite key constraint).
- `created_at`: Row creation timestamp for audit trail. Not nullable, part of audit compliance.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update for audit trail. Not nullable, required for audit compliance.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_categories`

Product category list (hierarchical) - Implements product categorization and navigation requirements. Maintains normalization by referencing parent self-row for hierarchy and separating product assignment. Used for category browsing, assigning products, and analytics. Key relationships: self-parent, products. Unique constraint prevents duplicate category names under same parent. Special behaviors: parent_id can be null (root category); unique name within parent. Fully auditable via timestamps.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key (UUID).
- `parent_id`: Optional parent category for hierarchy. Null means root category. References [shopping_mall_ai_product_categories.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_categories).
- `name`: Category name used for filtering, display, analytics. Not null, enforces clear navigation structure.
- `display_order`: Sort order among siblings. Implements UI/UX display requirement. Atomic, not calculated.
- `active`: Is this category active and visible to users? Not null, supports search/filtering.
- `created_at`: Category creation time for audit. Not null.
- `updated_at`: Category last update time for audit. Not null.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_bundles`

Product bundle master - Implements requirement for composite/bundle product types (multi-SKU). Maintains normalization by separating bundle/product mapping (via multi-relation). No calculated fields; price is explicit. Used for registering, querying, activating bundles. Key relationships: M:N with products. Audit support via timestamps. Behavioral notes: Only active bundles shown to customers; price is not auto-summed from products, always explicit.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `title`: Name of this bundle, used for search, navigation, analytic reporting. Atomic.
- `description`: Bundle overview text. Implements requirement for informative description. Atomic.
- `price`: Bundle price (explicit, not calculated). Implements business requirement for flexibility and control.
- `active`: Is this bundle available/visible now? Used for customer-facing filtering and search.
- `created_at`: Bundle creation time for audit row. Not nullable.
- `updated_at`: Bundle last update time for audit trail. Not nullable.

### `shopping_mall_ai_inventories`

Inventory tracking table - Implements strict real-time inventory control and auditability (per product and option-variant granularity). Follows 3NF by separating inventory and reservation state from products/options and excluding calculated values. Used for up-to-date stock validation and operational reporting. Relationships: FK to product, FK to option (nullable for base inventory). Auditable by timestamps. Unique inventory row per product/option. Key usage: reservation and availability queries, restock planning, shortage control. Special: Reserved cannot exceed quantity (enforced at application level).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key for inventory row.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Tracked product FK. References [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id`: Optional FK for option-variant specificity. References [shopping_mall_ai_product_options.id](#shopping_mall_ai_product_options).
- `quantity`: Quantity available in this inventory record. Implements atomic tracking of stock (not derived/calculated).
- `reserved_quantity`: Quantity reserved for fulfillment, not available for immediate sale. Separated for normalization and process control.
- `restock_at`: When new stock is expected (null if not planned). Supports supply chain visibility and planning. Optional.
- `created_at`: Inventory row create audit. Not nullable.
- `updated_at`: Inventory row last update audit. Not nullable.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_snapshots`

Product snapshot and versioning - Implements audit requirement for historical record of every change (register, update, delete) for compliance and analysis. Normalized by storing all persistent product data as serialized JSON (no denormalized fields here). Used for rollback, admin audit, and analytics. Relationships: FK to product. Behavioral notes: Only created_at timestamp kept (no modified field). 

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: FK to tracked product ([shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products)).
- `action`: Action that caused this snapshot (created/updated/deleted etc). Implements requirement for change log granularity.
- `snapshot_json`: Serialized JSON state of product at snapshot. 3NF-compliant; not calculated, atomic data blob.
- `created_at`: Time the change was snapshotted (never null).

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_options`

Product options (variants) - Implements multi-attribute SKU structures (size/color/etc.) separate from product records per normalization. Used for registration of product attributes, pricing structures, inventory granularity. Relationships: FK to product, unique SKU per product/option. Behavioral: Option_sku is always unique within product. Atomic, not calculated. 

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: FK to parent product ([shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products)).
- `name`: Option category name such as Size/Color. Required for variant registration.
- `value`: Option value, e.g., "Large" or "Red". Implements flexible attribute design.
- `option_sku`: Single SKU for this option/variant within the parent product requirement. Uniqueness enforced.
- `created_at`: Created at (audit row). Not nullable.
- `updated_at`: Updated at (audit row). Not nullable.

### `shopping_mall_ai_product_tags`

Product-tag M:N mapping - Implements flexible tagging for user search, analytics, AI recommendations (per requirements). Strict 3NF: each row is atomic, reference to one product and one tag. Used for assigning labels (seasonal, thematic, marketing), tagging analytics. Uniqueness constraint prevents duplicate tag for same product. Fully auditable.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: FK to associated product ([shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products)).
- `tag`: Text label for analytical/category/feature search. Not null, atomic, not derived.
- `created_at`: Audit field, row creation time. Not null.

### `shopping_mall_ai_ai_recommendations`

AI recommendation mapping - Implements surfacing requirement for AI-driven product recommendations per channel. Strict normalization: one mapping per product/channel, metadata stored as atomic blob. Used to link products to channels for tailored display/AI suggestions. Fully auditable, not calculated in table.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: FK to target product ([shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products)).
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: FK to channel ([shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels)), already created.
- `metadata_json`: Opaque serialized metadata for recommendation reasons, model output, etc.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (auditable).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (auditable).

### `shopping_mall_ai_carts`

Shopping cart representing short-lived user intent before checkout. Implements the requirement for separating intent/mutable cart state from transactional orders (see Cart & Order System doc). Maintains strict 3NF by isolating customer, channel, and section as FKs. For example, guest carts have null customer ID; multi-seller split is enabled by seller_id. Key relationships: links to customers/products/sessions/items. Special behaviors: cart can expire or be deleted if unused.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: Customer who owns this cart. Nullable for guest carts (intent tracking without persistent identity).
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Seller (if cart is seller-specific). Used for multi-seller/split-cart scenarios.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Channel the cart was created from (web/app/partner). Required for tracking context and analytics.
- `shopping_mall_ai_section_id`: Mall section/category that the cart applies to (for analytics, marketing, campaign scope).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for cart record. Used in cart expiry and abandoned cart logic.
- `created_at`: Time the cart was first created. Used for audit trail and analytics.

### `shopping_mall_ai_cart_items`

Cart item records - each row represents an atomic product/option/quantity selected in a cart. Implements requirement for normalized item representation in the Cart & Order System; avoids denormalized arrays. Usage example: Customer adds 2 products to cart, two rows are created. Key relationships: references carts and products; optional product_option for variants. Special behaviors: supports audit via timestamps, quantity changes, updates.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_cart_id`: Parent cart for this item (1:N relationship; must reference shopping_mall_ai_carts.id).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Product being considered for purchase (must reference shopping_mall_ai_products.id).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id`: Specific product option (e.g., color/size variant chosen; nullable if product has no variants).
- `quantity`: Quantity chosen in this cart item row. Atomic to maintain normalization and enable accurate order creation.
- `added_at`: Time this item was added to cart. Used for analytics and audit trail.
- `updated_at`: Time item was last modified. Used for detecting stale/reserved items.

### `shopping_mall_ai_cart_sessions`

Tracks guest/member session linkage to carts, enabling resume/sharing/expiration by session or device. Implements requirement for decoupling ephemeral session/cart lifecycles. Maintains normalization with session_token and cart FK (unique per token). For example, returning guest resumes session by session_token lookup. Key relationships: each session links to one cart. Special behaviors: auto-expiry, support guest/member migration.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_cart_id`: The cart this session is linked to. 1:N mapping for session to cart. Required for all records.
- `session_token`: Opaque token binding session to cart (guest modes, device restoration, etc.). Must be unique.
- `created_at`: Session creation timestamp. Used for audit and recall.
- `last_active_at`: Most recent activity timestamp for session expiry/cleanup.

### `shopping_mall_ai_orders`

Order record for each completed checkout event - This implements the need for atomic, auditable transaction records as per cart/order system and compliance requirements. Business purpose: provides a persistent, auditable record of sales including references to customer, channel, and all transactional relationships. Technical context: references customers, channels (both from other components), and aggregates items/payments/shipments. Maintains strict 3NF normalization; order-level calculated/summary fields are NOT stored here. Used for all order reporting, fulfillment, and analytics workflows. Key relationships: customer (buyer), channel (origin), order_items (breakdown), payments, shipments. Special behaviors: Immutable after completion for legal compliance. Timestamps support audit and temporal analytics.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key - Unique identifier for each order, enforcing entity integrity and traceability.
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: References the customer who placed the order. Links to [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers) from Actors domain for audit and reporting. Ensures 3NF normalization by externalizing identity.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Channel through which the order was placed. References [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels) for analytics and multi-channel support. Fully normalized design.
- `status`: Current workflow status (pending, paid, shipped, cancelled, completed). Implements requirement for full order lifecycle management. 3NF by isolating state as atomic value.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of order creation - Implements audit and analytics requirements. Ensures non-redundant atomic values (3NF). Used for event ordering and tracing.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last modification - For audit and compliance reporting. Maintains temporal integrity and normalization.

### `shopping_mall_ai_order_items`

Atomic breakdown for each product or SKU included in an order - Implements the requirement for line-item auditability and support for returns/analytics. Each row represents one discrete unit, normalized by separating all product/item info. Business purpose: supports quantity, price, and option-specific fulfillment, enabling precise return/cancel handling. Technical context: references order, product, and option from respective domains. Maintains strict 3NF. Used for inventory deduction, refund calculations, and SKU-level reporting. Key relationships: parent order, product/option, possibly option for variants. Special behaviors: status tracking for line-level returns/exchanges.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key - Unique identifier for each order item, enforcing atomicity and referential integrity.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Link to parent order's [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders) for 1:N relationship. Maintains strict normalization.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Reference to the purchased product. Ties to [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products) from ProductCatalog. Allows accurate analytics and inventory management.
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_option_id`: Optional reference to specific option/variant (nullable). Allows option-level granularity for stock/price tracking. Null means base product was selected. 3NF: no stored denormalized attributes.
- `price`: Unit price at order placement (not recalculated or aggregated later). 3NF: strictly atomic at point of entry, supports revenue recognition/audit.
- `quantity`: How many of this SKU/option were purchased in this line. Implements cart/order requirement. No aggregates.
- `status`: Line status (e.g., active, returned, cancelled) - Enables detailed return/exchange workflows. 3NF: lone code.
- `created_at`: Timestamp: entry creation (for audit trails, reporting).
- `updated_at`: Timestamp: last update (for returns/exchanges processing, analytics).

### `shopping_mall_ai_payments`

Payment transaction detail entity - Implements the requirement for split/multi-method payment scenarios, full audit trail, and financial reconciliation. Business purpose: tracks all payment and refund events, supporting post-sale processes. Technical context: references both order and payment channel. Enforces audit and compliance (timing and result tracking). 3NF: no redundant summaries. Used for payout reconciliation, fraud checks, and financial history. Key relationships: order, channel. Special behaviors: nullable resolution timestamp supports in-progress events.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key - Unique identifier for payment event, enabling precise financial and compliance tracking.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: References the order for which this payment occurred. [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders). Maintains strict normalization.
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Reference to payment channel/context (e.g., mobile, web, marketplace) - links to [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels) for multi-channel analytics. 3NF normalization.
- `method`
  > Payment method code (business determines available values). Implements 1payment type tracking for analytics/compliance.
  > Example: card, deposit, coupon, etc.
- `status`: Current payment status (pending, success, fail, refunded). Required for fintech workflow tracing. Not calculated.
- `amount`: Amount paid/refunded. Always atomic; reflects only this event, not order sum.
- `initiated_at`: When payment event initiated. Used for reconciliation, compliance, and reporting.
- `resolved_at`: When payment event resolved (nullable if in progress). Applies to audit requirement.

### `shopping_mall_ai_shipments`

Entity for logistics/fulfillment event(s) in order lifecycle - Implements requirement for multi-shipment, per-order event/fulfillment tracking as required in Cart & Order and Product Management. Business purpose: supports partial/delayed/split-shipment structures; enables full audit and reporting. Technical context: references parent order (from this domain), tracks logistics status and optional provider details. 3NF normalization, no denormalized product addresses or redundant tracking. Used for delivery time metrics, lost/delay resolution, and compliance. Key relationships: order, (future: 1:N item/shipment lines). Special behaviors: provider, tracking number nullable for pickup/non-carrier methods.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key - Unique for each shipment/fulfillment event, supports reliable auditing of shipping workflows.
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Parent order this shipment is tied to. References [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders). Maintains normalized structure for multi-shipment workflows.
- `status`: Current status of shipment (pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, etc.) as per workflow and analytics requirement. Implements workflow, full compliance with 3NF.
- `tracking_number`: Tracking code for logistics provider (nullable for pickup, non-trackable methods). Supports logistics integration.
- `provider`: Shipping/carrier provider name (nullable; carrier integration optional).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of shipment entity - used for reporting and compliance.
- `updated_at`: Last update/delivery timestamp; supports audit trails.

### `shopping_mall_ai_coupons`

Coupon definition entity implementing the requirements for system, seller, or product-specific coupons. This model ensures uniqueness of coupon codes, supports flexible targeting (seller/product/channel), and tracks business rules such as stacking, validity, and maximum use. Maintains 3NF by separating coupon event logs and preventing aggregate fields. Used when a customer attempts to redeem a coupon, and by admins for auditing eligibility, fraud, and campaign efficacy. Key relationships: events ([shopping_mall_ai_coupon_events](#shopping_mall_ai_coupon_events)), seller ([shopping_mall_ai_sellers](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers)), product ([shopping_mall_ai_products](#shopping_mall_ai_products)), and channel ([shopping_mall_ai_channels](#shopping_mall_ai_channels)). Special behavior: status flags enforce suspension/expiration, unique index prevents reuse of codes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_seller_id`: Issuer seller (nullable for platform-wide coupons). References [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers).
- `shopping_mall_ai_product_id`: Applicable product (nullable = all products). References [shopping_mall_ai_products.id](#shopping_mall_ai_products).
- `shopping_mall_ai_channel_id`: Channel scope (nullable = global coupon). References [shopping_mall_ai_channels.id](#shopping_mall_ai_channels).
- `code`: Coupon code - unique per coupon. Implements global eligibility requirement. E.g., 'SUMMER24', 'SELLER10'.
- `type`: Discount type, e.g., 'fixed', 'percent', or 'free_shipping'. Implements promo strategy selection.
- `value`: Discount value; business meaning depends on coupon type (fixed, %). Enforces atomic value for 3NF.
- `min_order_value`: Minimum order requirement for coupon use. Null = no restriction. Ensures separation from usage event data (normalization).
- `max_usage`: Max global redemptions for this coupon. Implements business anti-abuse rule. Atomic, 3NF-compliant.
- `max_usage_per_customer`: Max redemptions per customer. Enforces usage limit; 3NF-compliant.
- `valid_from`: Coupon start date/time (UTC). Supports audit/eligibility logic.
- `valid_until`: Coupon expiry (UTC). Required by business expiry rules and status auto-update.
- `stackable`: Can this coupon be combined with others? Implements stacking business rule.
- `status`: Coupon lifecycle status (e.g., active, expired, suspended). Triggers usage logic and admin control. 3NF-atomic.
- `created_at`: Coupon creation timestamp (audit/traceability requirement).
- `updated_at`: Coupon row update timestamp (audit, compliance).

### `shopping_mall_ai_coupon_events`

Coupon issuance, redemption, and audit event log. Implements audit trail and business fraud review requirement. Each event links a coupon to its associated customer and/or order (if applicable), and includes timestamp, type, and actor/admin info if needed. 3NF: no duplicate/calc data, all events atomic. Used to query redemption, abuse, or issue/expiry history. Relationships: coupon ([shopping_mall_ai_coupons](#shopping_mall_ai_coupons)), customer ([shopping_mall_ai_customers](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)), order ([shopping_mall_ai_orders](#shopping_mall_ai_orders)), actor ([shopping_mall_ai_sellers](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers) or [shopping_mall_ai_admins](#shopping_mall_ai_admins)).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_coupon_id`: Coupon being referenced. FK to [shopping_mall_ai_coupons.id](#shopping_mall_ai_coupons).
- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: Involved customer (nullable for non-customer events). FK to [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers).
- `shopping_mall_ai_order_id`: Order affected by event (nullable). FK to [shopping_mall_ai_orders.id](#shopping_mall_ai_orders).
- `shopping_mall_ai_actor_id`: Actor performing/logging event (seller/admin; nullable for system events). FK to [shopping_mall_ai_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_sellers) or [shopping_mall_ai_admins.id](#shopping_mall_ai_admins).
- `event_type`: Type of event for audit (issued, redeemed, expired, flagged, reviewed, etc.). Fulfills compliance and anti-abuse rules.
- `occurred_at`: Timestamp of event action (3NF-audit).
- `details`: Business or compliance note explaining event. Null = no comment.

### `shopping_mall_ai_deposits`

User deposit balance ledger implementing store credit management per refund, promotional grant, or manual adjust. Atomic model, 3NF (no aggregates). No pre-calc/rollup values. Used for customer eligibility checks and to power refund flows. Key relationship: customer ([shopping_mall_ai_customers](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)). Special behaviors: unique constraint on (customer, origin, status) to prevent duplicates/fraud.

- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: Customer owning this deposit. FK to [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers).
- `balance`: Store credit balance for user (never negative). 3NF-compliant; no rollup. Used for eligibility/audits.
- `updated_at`: Last modification time for auditability.
- `status`: Deposit lifecycle status (active, expired, etc.). Used by audit and credit eligibility checks.
- `origin`: Originating event for credit (e.g., refund). Implements business rules for refund tracking and analytic reporting.
- `expires_at`: Expiration date/time for credit (nullable). Enforces rule for time-limited promo/refund deposits.

Reward program point accrual/redemption/adjust event log. Fulfills loyalty point requirements (earning, redemption, admin adjust). Each record reflects an atomic event — 3NF. Used to power customer-facing point balances and admin reviews. Key relationship: customer ([shopping_mall_ai_customers](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)).

- `shopping_mall_ai_customer_id`: Customer for the event. FK to [shopping_mall_ai_customers.id](#shopping_mall_ai_customers).

- `amount`: Number of points changed; sign indicates earning (+) or redemption (-). 3NF events only (never rolled up in this table).

### `shopping_mall_ai_loyalty_events`

Loyalty system event log for audit, fraud review, and compliance snapshots. Used to track all major actions impacting loyalty/points, including admin overrides, expiry, and customer appeals. Each row is atomic and 3NF with full traceability. Relationships: customer ([shopping_mall_ai_customers](#shopping_mall_ai_customers)), optional actor ([shopping_mall_ai_admins](#shopping_mall_ai_admins) or seller).

- `event_type`: Type of loyalty event (awarded, redeemed, expired, revoked, reviewed, etc.). Supports audit/compliance rules.
- `points`: Quantitative points for event. Nullable if event non-numeric (e.g., review/flag). 3NF for rollup prevention.
- `details`: Additional info for audit. Null = no detail.
- `occurred_at`: Event timestamp for trace/audit purposes.

### `shopping_mall_ai_files`

Central file metadata entity. Manages uploaded binary resources with unique hash for deduplication, captures uploader type/id for audit. Related to assets and attachments. No direct FKs to actors (actor_id is cross-domain, thus no relation object).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `original_name`: Original file name at upload.
- `uri`: Blob store/CDN URI.
- `extension`: File extension.
- `mime_type`: Official MIME type.
- `size`: File size in bytes.
- `hash`: Content hash for deduplication/audit.
- `actor_type`: Uploader type (customer/seller/admin/system).
- `actor_id`: Actor id (cross-domain, not a strict FK).
- `created_at`: Upload timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete; cleanup state.

### `shopping_mall_ai_media_assets`

File asset variant. Always references base file, represents transformed or alternate asset (preview, thumb, compressed). All FKs resolved with IRelation object to file. Target for attachment links as well.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_file_id`: FK to base file.
- `asset_type`: Asset variant type.
- `asset_uri`: CDN/variant URI.
- `width`: Width (optional, images/video only).
- `height`: Height (optional).
- `duration`: Duration (optional, video/audio).
- `created_at`: Asset creation ts.

### `shopping_mall_ai_file_attachments`

Many-to-many join/attachment object linking files or asset variants to business objects. file_id and media_asset_id are each nullable; both always include relation config if present. Never null relation in AST. (Target polymorphism via target_type/id).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_file_id`: Optional FK to file. Includes relation if value is set.
- `shopping_mall_ai_media_asset_id`: Optional FK to file asset. Includes relation if value is set.
- `target_type`: Type of attached business object.
- `target_id`: ID of attached business object.
- `attached_at`: Attachment timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_ai_file_access_logs`

Normalized append-only log of each file access event. Strict FK for file_id (relation present), actor fields non-strict (cross-domain, ignored for fk/relation).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_ai_file_id`: FK to the file accessed.
- `actor_type`: Accessor type.
- `actor_id`: Accessor id, cross-domain.
- `access_type`: Access event type.
- `channel`: Access channel.
- `outcome`: Access outcome.
- `ip_address`: Access IP.
- `accessed_at`: Access timestamp.
